'''Aren Mador''' was the capital city of [[Essenia]], which was part of the [[Ten Nations]].

During their reconstruction after the [[Breaking of the World]], [[Ogier]] built a [[Ways|waygate]] to Aren Mador.{{ref/book|6|20}} The city later became [[Far Madding]].
